Section 1.04 As used herein, "Down-Zoning" shall mean a change in the
zoning district or an amendment of the Zoning Resolution, after the date hereof, that

Section 1.05 As used herein, “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean
certain rights and obligations, as determined by the Zoning Resolution, which are
appurtenant to a Zoning Lot, whereby such Zoning Lot may be developed by erecting
thereon one or more structures with the amount of Floor Area determined by multiplying

Section 1.06 As used herein, “Retained Floor Area" shall mean 6,199 square
feet of Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Townhouse Land.
Section 1.07 As used herein, "Up-Zoning" shall mean a change in the zoning
district or an amendment of the Zoning Resolution, after the date hereof, that increases
the Floor Area Development Rights applicable to all or a portion of the Zoning Lot.
Article II. GRANT OF FLOORAREA
Section 2.01 Owner hereby assigns, grants, transfers and conveys to Developer,
its successors and assigns, all of the right, title and interest of Owner in and to the
Developer's Floor Area, including, but not limited to the right to have, hold, use and
convey Developer's Floor Area. Owner agrees that Developer may utilize Developer's
Floor Area in construction of Developer's New Building, and that Developer, or a party
to whom Developer sells, transfers or conveys the Developer's Floor Area, may utilize
the Developer's Floor Area in construction of a building (an “Adiacent Building") on
property that is part of an enlargement of the Zoning Lot, together with other Floor Area
Development Rights as provided herein, or in any other manner permitted by law.
Neither Owner nor any person or entity claiming by, under or through Owner shall have
any right, title or interest in or to the Developer's Floor Area.
Section 2.02 To the extent that any action is required or any payment must be
made to a third party, to the City of New York, or any agency thereof, in order to
generate or utilize Developer's Floor Area, Developer shall be responsible for taking
such action or making such payment and Owner shall have no obligation to take such
